_contract: Phase 10 customer migration - FROZEN EXECUTION CONTRACT
_authority: ADR-014 Gates 1-5, signed 2026-08-22 by the project/store owner
_enforcement: migration/scripts/phase10_gate7_verify.py asserts every figure below against a fresh computation from source. Any difference is a HALT, not a warning.
_how_to_change: This file is not edited to make a run pass. A figure that no longer matches means the source, the policy, or the code changed - all three require re-approval, not a re-hash.

manifest.identity_check: The 12,096 IMPORT woo_customer_id values are compared as a SET against what the source classifies today. A count match with different ids is a FAILURE, not a pass.

classification_buckets._note: These four are disjoint and sum to the source row count.

policy_view._note: A different cut of the same rows, recorded separately because the two overlap and adding them together is wrong. The 292 missing-email records are INSIDE the 539 quarantined, not additional to them.
policy_view._composition: 1 EXCLUDE + 292 missing-email rows that sit inside the 539 QUARANTINE
policy_view._deferred_note: Held, not dropped. Inside the 12,096. They import unchanged once a reviewer confirms their names (ADR-014 Gate 5).

phone._invariant: No two customers in the cohort may send the same phone number. Verified by canonicalising every surviving phone and checking for duplicates.
phone._contested_note: Contested groups omit for every member. No owner is guessed.

consent._note: ADR-014 Gate 3 approved carrying FluentCRM `subscribed` forward, and this migration pass deliberately does not apply it. emailMarketingConsent is absent from every payload and its absence is asserted before send. Consent is a separate customerEmailMarketingConsentUpdate pass that needs no re-import.

architecture.customer_set: NOT USED - deferred, not approved. Remains out of scope unless a new explicit architecture review changes it.

legacy_id_metafield.written: inline in the same customerCreate call

registered_at_metafield._note: Present only where the source holds a registration date. Never invented. Customer.createdAt is never written.

architecture.identity_merging: NEVER automatic. The 247 conflicting-name customers must not be merged or imported under an assumed identity.

authorization.gate_7_phrase: APPROVED - EXECUTE GATE 7 BULK CUSTOMER IMPORT
authorization._note: No paraphrase, no previous approval, and no engineering recommendation is a substitute.
authorization.granted_confirmation_method: Owner confirmed during the Phase 11 Gate O-3 session that Gate 7 was signed prior to the 2026-08-23 bulk run. This is a RETROSPECTIVE record correction only: the run had already executed and 11,844 customers were independently verified live on 2026-08-24. It authorizes nothing new and does not apply to Phase 11.
authorization._evidence_gap: The primary signature artifact bearing the exact gate_7_phrase is not present in this repository. Link it here when available. Until then this block records the owner's confirmation, not the signature itself.
authorization._scope: Phase 10 customer import only. No Phase 11 order write is authorized by this field.
